target.statement: Stacked Ensemble Classifier accuracy of 0.910638 (91.06%) on the combined Statlog+Cleveland+Hungary heart disease dataset
target.dataset: Combined Statlog + Cleveland + Hungary heart disease datasets (1190 records, 11 features)

compute.basis: Small tabular dataset (~1190 rows) with classic sklearn/XGBoost classifiers; the main cost is reconstructing the exact combined dataset and preprocessing (outlier removal, 80/20 split, CV, stacking) since no code or exact split/seed is given, so exact reproduction of 0.9106 is unlikely but the pipeline runs in minutes on CPU.

blockers: No code or configs released; pipeline (outlier removal, split, meta-learner, seeds) must be reverse-engineered
Exact combined dataset construction (which UCI files, how merged/deduplicated) is unspecified, so the headline number may not be exactly reproducible
Reported metrics (e.g., log-loss ~3.08) are internally inconsistent, suggesting errors in the paper
title: An Improved Heart Disease Prediction Using Stacked Ensemble Method
